label: ATP Livslang Pension
name: Pension name
rightsHelp: Enter the gross annual amount on your ATP statement. Under the 2026 rules, DKK 3,600 a year or less is paid as a lump sum. Use the gross lump sum quoted by ATP.
lumpHelp: ATP pays the lump sum in the first eligible month and takes a 40% levy. The lump sum cannot be deferred under the 2026 rules.
monthlyHelp: Monthly payments can start the month after reaching Danish state pension age and can be deferred for up to 10 years.
deferralHelp: Use ATP's gross quote for the chosen later start. Leave this at zero to use the ordinary annual amount.
invalid.owner: Select an ATP recipient with a valid birth year and month.
invalid.name: Enter a pension name of up to 80 characters.
invalid.pension: Enter a nonnegative annual pension amount in DKK.
invalid.lump: Enter the gross lump sum from ATP in DKK.
invalid.deferred: Enter a deferred annual amount at least as high as the ordinary annual amount, or enter zero.
invalid.start: Choose the statutory first month, an age, a date or a milestone.
